name: Spirit Whisperer
theme: Apotheosis of the Necromancer Lord. Your minion court IS your weapon — they inherit your ferocity in full.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Minion count +2. Minions inherit your on-hit procs and combo-state creation.'
Pairs with witchdoctor.json spirit_whisperer path — same id, mirrors the path-7 capstone Soul Tether + amplifies via cap raise + full inheritance.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~21 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Necromantic Bond.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): minion-event hooks NOT yet wired — every node here is decorative until Phase F lands the minion event dispatch (onMinionAttack/Crit/Death + proc inheritance + minion HP/AS scaling stats).

nodes.name: Soul Anchor
nodes.description: Minions gain +2/4/6/8/10% maximum HP (foundation reservoir for the larger pack at capstone).

nodes.name: Spirit Conduit
nodes.description: Minions inherit +5/10/15% of your on-hit procs (preview of capstone full inheritance).

nodes.name: Soul Tether
nodes.description: On minion crit, +2/4/6/8/10% chance your next skill on the same target also crits.

nodes.name: Necromantic Bond
nodes.description: Minions are summoned with +25% duration permanently.

nodes.name: Death's Echo
nodes.description: On minion death, +20/40/60% chance to spawn a 4-second Spirit Echo dealing 50% of the original minion's damage.

nodes.name: Inheritor's Mark
nodes.description: Minion attacks have +25/50/75% chance to apply Hexed (cross-state via minions — pairs with the Voodoo Sovereign curse engine).

nodes.name: Pack Sovereign
nodes.description: Maximum minion count +2. Minions inherit your on-hit procs and combo-state creation in full. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
